stem: A 50/50 test has a sample ratio mismatch: treatment has clearly fewer users than control. Which of these is a likely cause?

options.text: The treatment page converts better, so more of its users go on to buy
The treatment page redirects users, and some are lost before they are logged
The test ran for two full weeks, so it covered every day of the week
Both groups draw their users from exactly the same mix of countries and devices
